name: Ganjue Buru O Shen
source:
You are correct, but "gOnshit infarct" is a brand new romance simulation visual novel developed by AGC GAMES. Together, you will defeat powerful enemies, find your lost mother, and gradually uncover the truth behind "gOnshit infarct."
